name: the Markdown table gains an empty body row
why: An empty <tr> leaves every cell's text unchanged, so only the row count can see it. That assertion used to lack an await on expect() (eslint playwright/missing-playwright-await). Checked 2026-10-04: the unawaited form ALSO caught this, because the test awaits again on the next line and the rejection surfaces there. It only worked by that accident; the last assertion in a test, written that way, could resolve after the test ends.
grep: a pipe table becomes a real table with a header row
